note: Short-lived issue-owned allowances introduced by newly synchronized mainline files. Exact ceilings describe default-SQLite-only drift; PostgreSQL runtime-only routes keep hard Repository/Adapter boundaries. Remove entries as #249/#251/#253 land.

lib/knowledgeTreeNoteScope.ts.reason: Main introduced synchronous note-scope helpers for the default SQLite knowledge-tree surface. PostgreSQL runtime-only uses dedicated knowledge-tree repositories and does not load this helper.

lib/knowledgeTreePasswordAccess.ts.reason: Main introduced synchronous folder-password visibility helpers for legacy routes. PostgreSQL runtime-only implements unlock/password access through its dedicated knowledge-tree repositories and does not load this helper.

middleware/api-token-resource-scope.ts.reason: Main added one additional synchronous token-resource lookup to the default runtime guard. PostgreSQL runtime-only does not mount the legacy token route/guard; request-time token resource enforcement remains the #249 async boundary task.

middleware/knowledgeCapabilityGuard.ts.reason: Main introduced a default-runtime synchronous knowledge capability guard. PostgreSQL knowledge-tree runtime performs capability checks through adapter-backed repositories and does not mount this middleware.

middleware/knowledgeSearchCapabilityGuar.reason: Main introduced a synchronous search capability guard for the default SQLite runtime. PostgreSQL search runtime has its own adapter-backed access path and does not mount this middleware.

routes/auth.ts.reason: Main expanded the default SQLite auth route after the reviewed baseline. PostgreSQL runtime-only authenticates directly through DatabaseAdapter users/user_sessions queries and does not mount routes/auth.ts; full cross-driver auth route parity remains #248 work.

routes/data-file.ts.reason: Main added one SQLite metadata statement to the legacy data-file administration/recovery route. PostgreSQL runtime-only exposes dedicated PostgreSQL backup/restore routes instead; cross-driver destructive data-file recovery remains #253.

routes/knowledge-tree.ts.reason: Main expanded the legacy unified knowledge-tree route after sync. PostgreSQL runtime-only mounts knowledge-tree-runtime.ts and knowledge-tree-surfaces-runtime.ts backed by dedicated repositories, so the additional SQLite route accesses remain isolated under #249.

routes/notes.ts.reason: Main added further statements to the default SQLite notes route. PostgreSQL runtime-only mounts notes-runtime.ts for the migrated note surface; remaining legacy note operations must move as the complete #249 transaction boundary.

services/knowledgeCapabilitiesResolver.t.reason: Main expanded synchronous capability resolution in the default runtime. PostgreSQL knowledge-tree routes use adapter-backed permission repositories and do not evaluate this legacy resolver.

services/knowledgeTreeBatch.ts.reason: Main introduced batch move/delete helpers around the synchronous SQLite knowledge-tree transaction. PostgreSQL runtime-only has dedicated structure/lifecycle mutation repositories; batch parity must be implemented atomically under #249.

services/noteTemplates.ts.reason: Main introduced note templates with synchronous note, attachment and knowledge-tree transactions. PostgreSQL schema parity includes template tables, but PostgreSQL runtime-only does not expose the template route yet; service migration remains a #249 runtime feature batch.

services/siyuanImportJobs.ts.reason: Main introduced durable SiYuan import jobs backed by the default SQLite database. Import execution is not mounted in PostgreSQL runtime-only and must migrate with the checkpointed cross-driver import pipeline under #251.

services/siyuanPackageImportLegacyCore.t.reason: Main added one statement to the legacy SiYuan bulk-import transaction. PostgreSQL runtime-only does not expose this importer; the complete import transaction remains owned by #251 rather than being partially converted.

routes/task-day-plans.ts.reason: Main introduced the Task My Day route after the reviewed direct-access snapshot. PostgreSQL runtime-only does not mount this SQLite route yet; its user/workspace/task transaction boundary must migrate with the remaining task repositories under #249.

routes/task-inbox.ts.reason: Main introduced personal task Inbox and quick capture after the reviewed direct-access snapshot. PostgreSQL runtime-only does not mount this SQLite route yet; migrate Inbox membership and capture transactions through shared repositories under #249.

routes/task-metadata.ts.reason: Main introduced task labels and saved views after the reviewed direct-access snapshot. PostgreSQL runtime-only does not mount this SQLite route yet; migrate its label, assignment and saved-view transactions through shared repositories under #249.

routes/task-time-blocks.ts.reason: Main introduced task estimates and personal time blocks after the reviewed direct-access snapshot. PostgreSQL runtime-only does not mount this SQLite route yet; migrate its task estimate and time-block lifecycle through shared repositories under #249.

services/workspace-deletion.ts.reason: Main extracted workspace deletion hierarchy transfer into a SQLite service after the reviewed snapshot. PostgreSQL runtime-only does not mount the legacy workspace deletion route; migrate the transfer transaction through a shared repository under #249.
